super-earth.title: Super Earth
super-earth.description: Super Earth is humanity's homeworld and the capital of the Federation of Super Earth. It is the political center of Managed Democracy and the seat of the federal government that directs the Super Earth Armed Forces, the Helldivers, and humanity's interstellar territories.

managed-democracy.title: Managed Democracy
managed-democracy.description: Managed Democracy is Super Earth's computerized voting system. Citizens answer questions and an algorithm determines which candidates best represent their choices, which Super Earth presents as eliminating the uncertainty of older democratic systems.

liberty-day.title: Liberty Day
liberty-day.description: Liberty Day is one of Super Earth's most important patriotic holidays and is celebrated annually on October 26. The holiday commemorates Managed Democracy and the citizens and soldiers who defend Super Earth's way of life. Traditions include re-swearing the Oath of Citizenship, watching the televised Lunar Bombardment, gathering gifts from town pyres, and celebrating the achievements of Super Earth and the Helldivers.

super-earth-national-anthem.title: Super Earth National Anthem
super-earth-national-anthem.description: The Super Earth National Anthem is the official musical anthem of Super Earth and celebrates the Federation, Managed Democracy, sacrifice, liberty, and humanity's supremacy across the galaxy. Instrumental versions of the anthem accompany patriotic activities such as raising the Super Earth Flag during Spread Democracy missions. The anthem also appears as an official track on the Helldivers 2 soundtrack.

malevelon-creek-memorial-day.title: Malevelon Creek Memorial Day
malevelon-creek-memorial-day.description: Malevelon Creek Memorial Day is a Super Earth holiday observed every year on April 3 in remembrance of the Helldivers who died fighting for Malevelon Creek. The holiday was established by presidential decree following the planet's liberation during the Second Galactic War. Citizens commemorate the fallen by dedicating three full minutes of their lunch break to solemn remembrance, while Helldivers were originally issued the Fallen Hero's Vengeance cape to carry the memory of the fallen into battle.

festival-of-reckoning.title: Festival of Reckoning
festival-of-reckoning.description: The Festival of Reckoning is Super Earth's winter holiday celebration, traditionally lasting three days and dedicated to love, family, peace, commerce, and vengeance against the enemies of Managed Democracy. Citizens gather with friends and family, purchase discounted consumer goods, sing holiday carols, and watch televised coverage of Helldiver victories. The celebration is supported by the annual Reckoning Fund, which finances additional ordnance for the Helldivers. The festival also includes traditions such as a dissident execution parade and the Feast of the Electorate.

feast-of-the-electorate.title: Feast of the Electorate
feast-of-the-electorate.description: The Feast of the Electorate is a celebration held during the Festival of Reckoning in honor of Super Earth's first free and Managed Election. It traditionally occurs on the third and final day of the Festival of Reckoning and represents the political culmination of the holiday's celebrations of family, peace, patriotism, and Managed Democracy.

reckoning-fund.title: Reckoning Fund
reckoning-fund.description: The Reckoning Fund is an allocation of resources set aside each year for the Festival of Reckoning. Rather than being devoted solely to civilian festivities, the fund finances additional ordnance and military activities so the Helldivers can deliver vengeance against the enemies of Super Earth for citizens to witness. Portions of the fund have also been used for experimental Stratagem testing during Festival campaigns.

super-earth-flag.title: Super Earth Flag
super-earth-flag.description: The Super Earth Flag is one of the Federation's most recognizable patriotic symbols and represents Super Earth, Managed Democracy, and humanity's authority across the galaxy. Helldivers deploy the flag during Spread Democracy operations, defending the area while it is raised over enemy-controlled territory. An instrumental version of the Super Earth National Anthem plays during the ceremony, turning the battlefield objective into a highly visible declaration of Super Earth sovereignty.

c-01-permit.title: C-01 Permit
c-01-permit.description: The C-01 Permit is a government authorization required before Super Earth citizens perform any act that could result in the conception of a child. The permit forms part of the Federation's population-control system and requires citizens to submit an application for government approval. C-01 availability has also been influenced by events in the Galactic War, with Super Earth suspending or increasing permit approvals in response to military and economic circumstances.

citizenship-classification-structure.title: Citizenship Classification Structure
citizenship-classification-structure.description: The Citizenship Classification Structure is the system used by the Federation to divide citizens into social classes. Six classes are currently known, ranging from Class A through Class F. Citizenship status can be influenced by service to Super Earth, with military personnel and their families sometimes receiving improved citizenship classifications as rewards for exceptional democratic service.

freedom-act.title: FREEDOM Act
freedom-act.description: The FREEDOM Act, formally the Freedom & Readiness to Enable Effective Defense & Obstruction of Mind-Influence Act of 2184, was enacted in response to the threat of Illuminate mind control and genetic manipulation. The law expanded the Ministry of Unity's authority to combat internal and external threats, created a new loyalty-enforcement security force known as the Unity Corps, and authorized construction of the Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety on Mastia.

wall-of-martyrs.title: Wall of Martyrs
wall-of-martyrs.description: The Wall of Martyrs is a Super Earth monument dedicated to members of the Helldivers and SEAF who die in service to the Federation. The names of fallen soldiers are inscribed upon the Wall, with Super Earth broadcasts claiming that millions of names are added every day. The monument is frequently referenced in military messaging, equipment descriptions, and propaganda, although its physical appearance has never been officially shown.

minor-barrier-reef.title: Minor Barrier Reef
minor-barrier-reef.description: The Minor Barrier Reef is a landmark located in Sector 1 of Super Earth. It was formerly known as the Great Barrier Reef, reflecting the Federation's renaming of the historic terrestrial landmark. Although little additional information is currently documented about it, the Minor Barrier Reef is one of the surviving named geographic landmarks connecting modern Super Earth to humanity's pre-Federation past.

presidential-security-bunker.title: Presidential Security Bunker
presidential-security-bunker.description: The Presidential Security Bunker is a fortified government facility located in Prosperity City and intended to protect the President of Super Earth during major emergencies. During the final Illuminate assault on Prosperity City in 2185, Great Host forces breached the bunker. The sitting President was killed in action while defending the facility with only a pistol, after which presidential authority was temporarily transferred to the Ministry of Defense.

victory-day.title: Victory Day
victory-day.description: Victory Day commemorates Super Earth's victory over the Illuminate Great Host during the Battle for Super Earth. The observance honors the millions of citizens and defenders who died during the invasion, including those who fought at Equality-on-Sea and the President who was killed during the siege of Prosperity City. In 2186, the first anniversary was preceded by the Victory Day Crusade, during which Helldivers were ordered to carry the war into Illuminate territory while continuing to defend Super Earth.

maximum-security-cities.title: Maximum Security Cities
maximum-security-cities.description: Maximum Security Cities are heavily fortified Super Earth cities designed to provide exceptional protection against dissidents, thoughtcriminals, and other threats to Managed Democracy. Their security systems include high-definition facial recognition cameras throughout buildings and city blocks, increased foot and drone patrols, and dedicated surveillance satellites. The first three Maximum Security Cities were constructed on Fort Union, Emeria, and Fort Sanctuary and named New Hope City, New Aspiration City, and New Yearning City.

405th-cyberwarfare-detachment.title: 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment
405th-cyberwarfare-detachment.description: The 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment is a Super Earth cyberwarfare formation associated with the decisive Fort Union cyberattack during the Battle for Super Earth. After a former satellite technician developed malware capable of disabling Illuminate technology, Helldivers defended Fort Union long enough for the code to be transmitted through the planet's long-range satellites. The malware disabled a significant portion of the Great Host, and the technician responsible received a field promotion to command the 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment.

maximum-security-city-construction-site.title: Maximum Security City Construction Site
maximum-security-city-construction-site.description: Maximum Security City Construction Sites were Super Earth points of interest established on Emeria, Fort Union, and Fort Sanctuary following Major Order A2-7-5. The sites were used to construct the Federation's first three Maximum Security Cities: New Aspiration City, New Hope City, and New Yearning City. The completed cities were designed with extensive security measures including high-definition facial recognition cameras, increased foot and drone patrols, and dedicated surveillance satellites.

terminid-research-preserve.title: Terminid Research Preserve
terminid-research-preserve.description: The Terminid Research Preserve was a planet-wide Super Earth quarantine facility established on Acamar IV. The preserve allowed researchers to study live Terminids and provided a large supply of specimens for E-710 extraction and scientific research. Its containment measures included SEAF Wardens, above- and below-ground electrical fencing, and automatic nuclear bombardment protocols. The preserve was ultimately destroyed after a catastrophic subterranean Terminid outbreak erupted beneath Tyranny Park and spread to neighboring planets.

tyranny-park.title: Tyranny Park
tyranny-park.description: Tyranny Park was a public attraction located within the Terminid Research Preserve on Acamar IV. Wealthy Super Earth citizens could visit the park to observe Terminids in a controlled environment, while particularly adventurous visitors could participate in Big Tyrant Hunts. Revenue from the attraction was intended to support Terminid research and E-710 production. The park became the site of disaster when a massive subterranean Terminid hive erupted beneath it during the catastrophic failure of the preserve.

center-of-science.title: Center of Science
center-of-science.description: The Center of Science is a major Super Earth research facility located on Fenrir III. Constructed in 2184, it became home to leading astrophysicists studying the Meridian anomaly, Dark Fluid, Dark Energy, and Illuminate-related phenomena. Research conducted there helped reveal the unusual nature of the Meridian object and contributed to Super Earth's attempts to understand and counter its movement. The facility later became strategically important enough to draw attacks from multiple enemy factions.

seaf-soldier.title: SEAF Soldier
seaf-soldier.description: SEAF Soldiers are lightly armored conventional infantry serving in the Super Earth Armed Forces. They fight with weapons including assault rifles, submachine guns, machine guns, expendable anti-tank launchers, and grenades. SEAF Soldiers can be encountered defending Mega Cities and can also be deployed from Pelican Shuttles on planets with a Heavy SEAF Presence. Helldivers can recruit nearby squads to follow and support them in combat.

seaf-squad.title: SEAF Squad
seaf-squad.description: A SEAF Squad is a conventional Super Earth infantry formation that can support Helldivers during planetary operations. A standard deployed squad consists of one Squad Leader, two Riflemen, two Specialists, and one Medic. The soldiers follow their Squad Leader, and a Helldiver who recruits the Squad Leader gains the support of the entire squad.

heavy-seaf-presence.title: Heavy SEAF Presence
heavy-seaf-presence.description: Heavy SEAF Presence is a planetary modifier indicating that conventional Super Earth Armed Forces are heavily deployed on a world and can directly support Helldiver missions. When active, Pelican Shuttles can deploy SEAF infantry squads into mission areas to reinforce Helldivers engaged with enemy forces. The modifier was introduced during Operation Void Piercer.

seaf-training-facilities.title: SEAF Training Facilities
seaf-training-facilities.description: SEAF Training Facilities were massive emergency military training centers constructed during the early Second Galactic War to rapidly expand the Super Earth Armed Forces. Facilities were established on Aesir Pass, Vernen Wells, Heeth, and Angel's Venture and were capable of supporting enormous numbers of recruits through SEAF basic training. While operational and under Super Earth control, the facilities increased SEAF support for galactic liberation campaigns.

democratic-youth-scouts-camps.title: Democratic Youth Scouts Camps
democratic-youth-scouts-camps.description: Democratic Youth Scouts Camps were recreational campgrounds created from surviving emergency SEAF Training Facilities after Super Earth's military recruitment requirements had been met. The facilities on Heeth and Angel's Venture were shut down and converted for use by the Democratic Youth Scouts. The Angel's Venture campground was later destroyed along with the planet, while the status of the Heeth campground remains uncertain.

zegema-paradise-training-facility.title: Zegema Paradise Helldiver Training Facility
zegema-paradise-training-facility.description: The Zegema Paradise Helldiver Training Facility was authorized in 2185 as a replacement for the Helldiver training site lost on Mars. Super Earth launched a major recruitment expansion and ordered Helldivers to secure Terminid-controlled worlds and collect fifty million Terminid samples to support breeding programs for live-fire training. The facility was intended to provide the same elite Helldiver training previously conducted at the Mars installation.

rogue-research-station.title: Rogue Research Station
rogue-research-station.description: Rogue Research Stations are unauthorized Super Earth research facilities encountered on planetary battlefields. The stations contain research deemed unpatriotic by the Federation and are therefore marked for destruction. Helldivers are ordered to demolish the facility and eliminate the illegally produced research data, commonly using a Hellbomb or other sufficiently powerful ordnance.

super-earth-colony.title: Super Earth Colony
super-earth-colony.description: Super Earth Colonies are organized human settlements established across Federation-controlled planets. Unlike the enormous Metropolises found in major urban regions, colonies occupy only part of a planetary mission area and contain networks of roads, buildings, civilian infrastructure, and military installations. Colony infrastructure can include SEAF Artillery, SAM Sites, ICBM Launch Sites, evacuation facilities, storage plants, broadcast towers, and data uplinks.

metropolis.title: Metropolis
metropolis.description: A Metropolis is an enormous urban megastructure constructed by the Super Earth Federation. Unlike smaller colonies, a Metropolis can encompass an entire planetary mission area. These densely developed regions contain extensive road networks, city blocks, skyscrapers, parks, playgrounds, and smaller structures. Metropolises form the urban environments of major Federation population centers, including the Mega Cities of Super Earth.

voteless-processing-plant.title: Voteless Processing Plant
voteless-processing-plant.description: The Voteless Processing Plant was a specialized Super Earth scientific facility constructed during the Census Thunder campaign. Automaton bio-processing equipment captured on Blistica was repurposed alongside millions of Voteless tissue samples collected by Helldivers. The facility's bio-centrifuges processed Void-altered Voteless tissue for Ministry of Science research, helping Super Earth investigate the biological effects of the Void.

dss-logistics-hub.title: DSS Logistics Hub
dss-logistics-hub.description: The DSS Logistics Hub was a major Super Earth facility established on Tarsh to support construction and operation of the Democracy Space Station. The hub provided logistical support for the immense quantities of personnel, materials, fuel, and technology required by the project. Its strategic importance made Tarsh a critical location during the DSS construction effort and a target of Automaton attacks.

advanced-weapons-lab.title: Advanced Weapons Lab
advanced-weapons-lab.description: The Advanced Weapons Lab on X-45 was an abandoned Super Earth research installation containing plans for a powerful interplanetary battle station. During the Second Galactic War, Helldivers defended X-45 and secured the plans held within the facility. Those plans became the foundation of the Democracy Space Station project, making the laboratory an important part of the DSS's origins.

varylia-5-petafactory.title: Varylia 5 Petafactory
varylia-5-petafactory.description: The Varylia 5 Petafactory was a massive Automaton manufacturing complex discovered on Varylia 5 in May 2184. Its design resembled the Morgunson Arsenal on Tien Kwan. Super Earth determined that the facility could be converted to manufacture a dual-autocannon Exosuit, prompting Helldivers to liberate the planet. Following their victory, Super Earth engineers retrofitted the captured Petafactory for production of the EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit.

morgunson-arsenal.title: Morgunson Arsenal
morgunson-arsenal.description: The Morgunson Arsenal on Tien Kwan is a major Super Earth military manufacturing facility associated with the production of Exosuit technology. When Automatons captured Tien Kwan on March 7, 2184, Super Earth ordered an immediate counteroffensive to prevent the enemy from discovering and stealing the technology. Helldivers liberated the planet the following day, recovering the arsenal and its stockpile of newly produced EXO-45 Patriot Exosuits intact.

deep-mantle-forge-complex.title: Deep Mantle Forge Complex
deep-mantle-forge-complex.description: The Deep Mantle Forge Complex is a Super Earth industrial facility on Claorell established during construction of the Democracy Space Station. Helldivers liberated Automaton deep-mantle mining infrastructure on the planet so it could be repurposed for the project. Using the extreme heat and pressure near Claorell's core, the complex produces chromium-cobalt-nickel alloys strong and ductile enough to help the DSS withstand the acceleration forces of faster-than-light travel.

factory-hub.title: Factory Hub
factory-hub.description: The Factory Hub is a major industrial facility on Achernar Secundus constructed by AM Defense under a multitrillion-Supercredit Ministry of Defense contract. The complex produces military equipment and other goods important to Super Earth's war effort. Its construction began in December 2184, and the facility later became associated with development and production of Fast Recon Vehicles for Helldiver forces.

negative-energy-laboratory.title: Negative Energy Laboratory
negative-energy-laboratory.description: The Negative Energy Laboratory was a Super Earth research facility established on Pilen V in April 2185. Its scientists investigated Dark Energy and the poorly understood Negative Energy associated with Illuminate phenomena such as Monoliths. The facility may have been intended to replace research capabilities lost with the Moradesh Research Facility, but it survived for only a short period before being destroyed.

e-711-extraction-facility.title: E-711 Extraction Facility
e-711-extraction-facility.description: The E-711 Extraction Facility is a Super Earth industrial installation on Oshaune constructed to recover Element-711 from deposits beneath the former Hive World. Extensive drilling and mining operations were established after Oshaune's liberation in November 2185 to extract the valuable substance. The recovered E-711 later enabled Super Earth to synthesize Dark Fluid, providing an important new source of the exotic material.

moradesh-research-facility.title: Moradesh Research Facility
moradesh-research-facility.description: The Moradesh Research Facility was a Super Earth scientific installation established to study and weaponize Illuminate Dark Fluid for use against the Meridia Supercolony. During research in May 2184, an accident caused exotic material within the facility to collapse into a temporary micro-black hole, killing twelve scientists before evaporating. Research conducted at Moradesh ultimately contributed to the Dark Fluid weapon deployed against Meridia. The facility was later evacuated before Moradesh itself was destroyed by the Meridian Black Hole in March 2185.

ultramafic-mine.title: Ultramafic Mine
ultramafic-mine.description: The Ultramafic Mine is a strategic mining complex on Mintoria originally constructed in secret by the Automatons. The facility extracted uncommon metals from deep ultramafic rock deposits, including nickel, chromium, and platinum. Super Earth discovered the operation through decrypted Automaton communications and ordered Helldivers to liberate Mintoria, securing the mine and technological assets associated with it.

center-for-civilian-surveillance-and-saf.title: Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety
center-for-civilian-surveillance-and-saf.description: The Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety is a Super Earth surveillance facility on Mastia overseen by the Ministry of Truth. Expanded under the FREEDOM Act, it developed systems for identifying citizens considered at risk of disloyal thought and trained undercover personnel. Its later investigation reported dissident activity on every Federation planet except Super Earth itself, helping trigger the War on Dissidence.
aliases: center for civilian surveillance and safety

pre-dissidence-program.title: Pre-Dissidence Program
pre-dissidence-program.description: The Pre-Dissidence Program is a Super Earth internal-security initiative associated with the Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety. It was created to identify citizens considered at risk of future disloyal thought so authorities could intervene before dissident activity occurred.

center-for-confinement-of-dissidence.title: Center for the Confinement of Dissidence
center-for-confinement-of-dissidence.description: The Center for the Confinement of Dissidence, abbreviated CECOD, is a planet-wide high-security Super Earth detention and re-education facility on Afoyay Bay. Constructed after the War on Dissidence overwhelmed existing holding facilities, it was designed to contain up to 15 million dissidents. Its detainees were later used as the workforce for nearby Pandora Base.
aliases: center for the confinement of dissidence

pandora-base.title: Pandora Base
pandora-base.description: Pandora Base is a top-secret Super Earth development and manufacturing facility on Afoyay Bay commissioned by the Ministry of Expansion during Operation Free Space. The facility was established to construct upgrades for the Democracy Space Station, including the Star of Peace, using labor supplied by detainees from the nearby Center for the Confinement of Dissidence.

seaf-bug-wardens.title: SEAF Bug Wardens
seaf-bug-wardens.description: SEAF Bug Wardens were Super Earth Armed Forces personnel assigned to containment and security duties at the Terminid Research Preserve on Acamar IV. They helped maintain the preserve's quarantine systems and monitored the captive Terminid population before the facility was destroyed by a catastrophic subterranean outbreak.

super-defense-protocols.title: Super Defense Protocols
super-defense-protocols.description: The Super Defense Protocols are emergency global defense measures reserved for situations in which Super Earth itself faces an extreme military threat. They were activated during the First Battle for Super Earth. Protocol Sapphire converted the remaining rainforests into tactical Eagle airstrips and reduced Eagle rearm time; Protocol Diamond suspended Collateral Damage Mitigation Procedures and augmented Helldiver loadouts with Orbital Napalm Barrage; Protocol Ruby opened Super Destroyer high-cost reserves and augmented loadouts with the Fast Recon Vehicle.
